1.consolidated_definition: mod. Modelo fotográfica que posa para las revistas ilustradas, especialmente para las portadas. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. A finales de la década de los cincuenta era difícil no ver la escultural y aristocrática figura de Dorian Leigh ocupando la portada de las grandes revistas del mundo de la moda, como Vogue. Era algo más que una cover girl, fue toda una inspiración
1.en_consolidated_definition: Photographic model posing for illustrated magazines, especially for covers. Raw anglicism, frequent. At the end of the 1950s, it was difficult not to see the sculptural and aristocratic figure of Dorian Leigh occupying the cover of major fashion magazines such as Vogue. She was more than a cover girl; she was an inspiration.
